title: No payload access before the signature is verified
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation.

statements.label: No payload access before the signature is verified
statements.requirement: The API SHALL make the payload and claims reachable only through a successful verification result type. Code that inspects an unverified payload SHALL go through an explicitly named unsafe or diagnostic call.

sources.quote: Verify the signature before processing the payload.
The Issuer Signature SHALL also be verified before any processing of the contents of the HCERT takes place.
